what: What is stopping us, in plain words. Hand-written because a machine cannot say who is waiting on whom. A blocker that clears is DELETED, not marked done.

blockers.what: Thirteen safety checks are failing and nobody had said so
blockers.why: While fixing what a real founder sees, three separate agents reported the same thing independently: thirteen of our fifty-nine checks are red on the main branch, and have been for days. One of them — the check on the very machinery we fixed today — had been red since Sunday and went unmentioned for five days. A check nobody reads is not a check.

blockers.what: Nine of the companies we grade ourselves against won a fund that no longer exists
blockers.why: Our score is measured against what nine hundred companies actually won. For nine of them the scheme has since closed — so part of the target is unreachable by definition, and it was quietly inflating one of our numbers rather than measuring the product. Found only because we stopped a dead scheme being recommended and watched what happened to the score.
